cards.definition: Membrane-bound organelle that generates most of the chemical energy needed to power the cell's biochemical reactions.
Macromolecular machine that synthesizes proteins by translating messenger RNA sequences.
Organelle that modifies, sorts, and packages proteins and lipids for secretion or delivery to other cellular destinations.
Digestive vesicle containing hydrolytic enzymes that break down cellular waste.
Continuous membrane network involved in protein folding and lipid synthesis.
Plant cell organelle that converts light energy into sugars via photosynthesis.
Dense region inside the nucleus where ribosomal RNA is transcribed and assembled.
Small organelle that oxidizes fatty acids and neutralizes hydrogen peroxide.
Network of protein filaments that gives the cell shape and enables movement.
Selective phospholipid bilayer separating the cell interior from its environment.
Microtubule-organizing center that regulates cell division spindle formation.
Fluid-filled sac that maintains turgor pressure and stores nutrients or waste.
Enzyme complex that synthesizes adenosine triphosphate using a proton gradient.
Complex of DNA and histone proteins that condenses to form chromosomes.
